items.item:
11. A correction that changes a project moves its revision by exactly one and
   sets its last-changed instant to the current instant; one that changes
   nothing leaves both. Shows A04-3, A04-6.
   [witness: verification:registry_a04_change_moves_revision_and_last_changed]
statements: accepted and changed(r) and r keeps a revision   -- A04-3
accepted and not changed(r) => r.revision' = r.revision   -- A04-6

verdicts.item:
11. A correction that changes a project moves its revision by exactly one and
   sets its last-changed instant to the current instant; one that changes
   nothing leaves both. Shows A04-3, A04-6.
   [witness: verification:registry_a04_change_moves_revision_and_last_changed]
statements: accepted and changed(r) and r keeps a revision   -- A04-3
accepted and not changed(r) => r.revision' = r.revision   -- A04-6
verdicts.why: The check detects successful changing corrections and verifies that each advances the revision exactly once and stamps the current clock instant. It also submits an equal correction, verifies it reports no change, and confirms both the returned and persisted revision and last-changed instant remain unchanged.
